summary: Resets an array of per-vehicle state entries. Reads the entry count at this+0xBA8; if greater than zero, iterates entries with a 187-float (748-byte) stride starting at this+747 floats, calling sub_4DF110(entry, 0.0, -1) on each and clearing the entry's sixth float (this+0xBC4) to 0.0. Called by VehicleRespawnReset.

operations.description: Read the entry count from this+0xBA8; if it is not greater than zero the loop is skipped entirely.
Initialize the entry pointer at this+747 floats (start of the entry array); entries advance by a 187-float stride.
Iterate while the running index is below the count at this+0xBA8; the count is re-read from this+0xBA8 each iteration for the loop bound.
Call sub_4DF110(current_entry, 0.0, -1) to reset the entry's state with a zero value and -1 sentinel.
Clear the entry's sixth float at this+0xBC4 to 0.0.
Return the last-read count from this+0xBA8. VehicleRespawnReset (0x004E0800) calls this during respawn reset.
